posts.author: karpathy
posts.text:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.
posts.text_zh:
周末小项目：HackerTube。我受够了 YouTube 的推荐，于是让 Claude 把 HN 20 年来的 4300 万条评论筛了一遍，提炼出 6,454 个被反复推荐的视频。观看体验*明显*更好，用 Opus 5.5 花了大约 2 小时：
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- 无需登录就有出色的推荐（状态保存在本地浏览器会话里）
- 缩略图取自视频中段的一个代表性画面，而不是那些经过 A/B 测试、极度优化过的上传者自制封面
- 评论分析的底层数据打包成一个 zip 文件，把你的 Claude 指向它，就能让它给你做一个专属版本
- HackerTube 长视频版 ✊

再多说说过程：
我用的是 Claude Code（Mac 桌面应用），默认用 Opus 5.5、Medium 推理强度。我只跟 Claude 对话，让它包办一切，我唯一配合做的“手工活”都在浏览器里（让人想起 MenuGen）：1）我得在 Google Cloud 控制台里创建一个 API key，用来查询 YouTube 的视频元数据；2）我开了一台 VPS 用来部署；3）我买了域名。机器开起来后，我把 IP 给了 Claude，让它更新、加固、部署并优化代码，它全都搞定了。

很多原本要花几周甚至几个月的出色项目，现在早餐时间几次尝试就能做出来。还有什么是我们还没想到的？

posts.author: levelsio
posts.quoted_text:
Hard to overstate how big of a deal this is.

tl;dr — ANY unpatched Linux server with even a single TCP port exposed to the internet (say for HTTP or SSH) and MPTCP active (default for many Go web servers) is vulnerable to complete takeover. https://t.co/1oqoxRuMM6
posts.text:
This is why I said you want your VPS ports all closed

Then only let it be accessible inside your Tailscale for SSH and via a Cloudflare Tunnel to receive web traffic

Any Linux box can be taken over with just a single TCP port exposed to the internet now

A stop gap is disabling https://t.co/FqprfAid2j
posts.text_zh:
这就是为什么我说你的 VPS 端口要全部关掉

然后只让它在你的 Tailscale 内网里通过 SSH 访问，再通过 Cloudflare Tunnel 接收 Web 流量

现在任何一台 Linux 机器，只要有一个 TCP 端口暴露在公网上，就可能被完全接管

临时止血办法是禁用 https://t.co/FqprfAid2j
posts.quoted_summary_zh: 被引帖称这事影响巨大：任何未打补丁、只要有一个 TCP 端口（如 HTTP 或 SSH）暴露在公网且启用了 MPTCP（很多 Go Web 服务器默认开启）的 Linux 服务器，都可能被完全接管（被引帖浏览约 74.7 万）。
